question: Should PR 97669 be the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97553, or should maintainers prefer another open candidate?
rationale: Several contributor PRs implement the same auth-provider recovery path, and automation should not choose the permanent branch or close siblings.

options.title: Make PR 97669 canonical

options.title: Pause for channel proof
